notes.title: Polished Demo (&More)
notes.notes:

notes.title: Chaos Mode (New Trailer)
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings from the void...[/b]

Hello, everyone. You may have noticed...that your copy of Emblems: Sunless Vow the demo has an update available. Well. That might be because...

🎉 [b]The first taste of Chaos Mode is finally here![/b] 🎉

And we've updated our trailers + screenshots accordingly. Do check them out if you'd like a quick preview!


Chaos Mode features...

[list]
[*]Procedurally generated maps that change with each run, as well as a wider range of game mechanics. Right out of the gate, you'll be battling Vengeful Spirits, Support enemies, and wacky modifiers! 
[*]Access to over 50 Favors (100+ in the full game!), which provide upgrades for the entire run.
[*]An upgradeable shop with a devilish shopkeeper, who is very...erm. Grateful. For your patronage... (You'll see.)
[*]Flexible difficulty! 3 main difficulty settings + 7 optional Tribulations. And, just like in Story mode, you will always accumulate experience towards persistent upgrades, even if you get a game over.
[*]A "Mastery" system. Fulfill special requirements to unlock Mastery, another form of meta-progression!
[*]...and more!
[/list]
[b]By the way...if you're a streamer,[/b] or if you know one who may enjoy our game—please feel free to let us know! [u]We now feature a list of all streamers who have played Emblems right there in the game itself,[/u] when you finish either mode. We'll update it every week from now on, so...don't be shy!

This is one of the best ways for us to spread the word of our game, so we truly appreciate each and every streamer, no matter how small.

Lastly... Work on the rest of the game is proceeding apace. At this time, we hope to release the full game around December. Tell your friends! Make them wishlist...! (Okay, don't do that, but you [i]can[/i] ask them nicely.)

You can also consider [b]leaving a review on our new separate demo page![/b] (Thank you...!)

That's all from us. See you soon,
[i]Tonic & Ikiru[/i]

notes.title: New Demo!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings from the void...[/b]

We hope you're well!

March 3rd...is finally here. Which means...

[h3]The time to unleash our [b]updated demo[/b] upon the populace has come![/h3]

We've worked hard, and hope you'll enjoy the...

[list]
[*] Condensed Narrative (30 min to play the whole demo!)
[*] Additional CGs

notes.title: Progress Update (Demo & Buffs)
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings from the void...[/b]

It's that time again. Yes, that's right. Today, the two of us bring you a brief update on our development progress.

1. [u]We have restructured our introduction, and are continuing to make our demo more "efficient."[/u]

As a result of shortening our first mega-scene, we realized it would be good to rearrange some other parts of our demo as well.

[b]In sum, the demo will now end after Chapter 2[/b] [i]- but it will contain many more exciting things in the shorter duration![/i] (Trust us. It's true.)

[u]Some of the less-secret, but still exciting things are[/u]: an additional CG, so many UI updates, various effects & background adjustments, and that promised taste of Chaos Mode.

[b]The demo is down for now,[/b] while we complete these changes. (audience awws) However, we aim to reupload it in January or so. It should feel quite different, so, when the time comes... We hope you'll give it another spin.

2. [u]We have now implemented ~50 buffs for Chaos Mode,[/u] [i]the roguelite version of the game, and are continuing to refine the first map for its inclusion in the demo.[/i]

We're quite excited about this other play mode. We can't stop making new buffs. Well, we can, but when we do that, we accidentally make new special enemies, and additional bosses instead. Oh, and a barrier system, for blocking damage on-demand...

3. [u]We have restructured Story Mode's Relic unlocks to be a simple skill tree instead of a linear unlock.[/u]

And don't you know it... [b]Chaos Mode has its own special version,[/b] which includes unlocking new buffs, choosing Permanent Buffs, and culling your options with Banned Buffs.

That's it for now. As always, we've kept it very general... But we're hard at work every day, doing what we love.

We hope to see you in December, for the next progress update - [b]and some special news![/b] (Possibly related to a certain tsundere grim reaper...)

[i]Tonic & Ikiru[/i]

notes.title: Progress Update (Intro & Chaos)
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings from the void...[/b]

We hope you're well. Today, the two of us bring you a brief update on our development progress.

1. [u]We are currently condensing the introduction to our game.[/u]

This includes the initial dialogue scene + tutorial. The streamlined version will allow you to get to the gameplay faster, is flashier, and truer to the action-setting of the story.

2. [u]We are now testing Chaos Mode, the roguelite version of the game.[/u]

We plan to release a taste of it in our next big demo update. If you enjoy being mercilessly battered by the void, we think you'll like it.

3. [u]We are creating a Party Reward mechanic[/u] that awards buffs regularly throughout each Chapter, based on the total number of levels you have accumulated. For example: "Damage all enemies when gaining a level."

4. [u]We are also creating a Type Advancement mechanic[/u] that gives unique upgrades to each type, based on how often they are used. For example, Weapon-Type emblems gain extra Defense at a certain threshold.

Our next goal is to add the above changes, as well as several other improvements, to a "big demo update." (And of course, most of those will benefit the full game as well.)

But in the mean time...we'll see you in another 3-4 weeks with the next progress update!

notes.title: Bug Fixes (Balance & Reference)
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings from the void.[/b]

The two of us are hard at work on refining the intro to the game. And of course, completing the rest of the 13 Chapters!

[b]But in the mean time, we've brought you... A balance adjustment. And minor bug fixes.[/b]

• Balance: Boosted the experience bonus of the Precision Advantage to +75%

• Fix: The Type + Crit References will now stay active in the bottom-right corner after Chapter 3.
• Fix: Tutorial boxes for new mechanics will now show every time you start the battle in which they are introduced.
• Fix: Story scenes will now only be skipped by clicking the "Skip" arrow in the top-right of the screen.
• Fix: If the "Scrolling Background" setting is disabled, the screen warp intro to boss battles will also be disabled.
• Fix: Music will now fade out properly in certain situations. (All of them, we hope.)

• Polish: Minor edits to opening cinematic.

notes.title: New Feature (Support Enemies)
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings from the void. We've brought you...a new feature! [/b] A crit change! And minor bug fixes.

• New Feature: Added "Support Enemies" to Chapters 4 – 6. Support enemies apply a temporary buff to other enemies, creating more varied scenarios in the middle of battle (that aren't quite as game-changing as a Modifier). This mechanic was already designed for Chaos mode, but we decided to bring it into Story to add more variety.

• Balance: We have changed the mechanic of Spirit’s Crit. It now deals 1 extra damage and heals 1 Vit for every 2 Vit missing. At 50% Vit, this will be identical to the original version...but it will become much stronger now, as his Vit decreases. Will you take the risk?

• Fix: Controller input will no longer go into super slow-mo during Relic unlocks.
• Fix: The Mercy of Growth will now be unlocked appropriately.
• Polish: Darkened battle backgrounds to better emphasize the active play elements.
• Polish: Changed in-battle text box behavior to be less likely to accidentally skip dialogue.

notes.title: Bug Fix - Retry (Bosses)
notes.notes:
Edit: Anyone who had enabled "Skip Dialogue" can now also join in on the bug-fix-fun below.

[b]Greetings from the void. We've brought you...a major bug fix for the boss fights![/b]

Let's have a nice, big shout-out to the hero who sent us such kind and detailed feedback regarding this issue. (Applause) 

[u]And remember: You too can be kind and detailed...when you press the Report Bug button today, found on the Main Menu of the game.[/u] Do let us know of any strange issues you encounter while playing. We'll do our best to fix them quickly.

• Major Fix: Retrying from the Game Over screen will now return you to the main menu, where you can click "Continue" to try the fight again. This will fix many potential issues.

• Fix: Enemy attacks that hit 2+ targets will no longer cause issues if there are no additional targets to hit.
• Fix: Choosing “End” in the Game Over screen will now properly check the max Relic level for the Demo.
• Fix: Can no longer select an Emblem at the end of an Advantage Room.
• Fix: Can no longer open the Relic while viewing the map from an Advantage Room.
• Fix: Can no longer select nodes while the Relic is open on the map.
• Fix: Adjusted Map 1 Room 2 to prevent a possible tutorial error.
• Fix: Adjusted Opening Skip button.
• Balance: Emblems that gain a level from Fortuna’s “Amends” attack will no longer gain Vit.
• Polish: Minor text edits.
